title: SYNCRAFT
description:
A modpack for the coming-soon server, syncraft!

A valkyrien skies focused kitchen sink modpack that makes ground survival nearly impossible. Features MCEF, Create, aesthetic add-ons, painting creation and more!
body:
# SYNCRAFT

update: we're testing on a private server! IP will be posted here before 5/1/26!

syncraft is a compilation of EOSYN's favorite mods intended for a modded server, built entirely around valkyrien skies and eureka, with the goal of having as many functional and compatible mods stacked on top of it as possible. 

the ground is difficult, if not impossible to survive on. everything is trying to kill you desperately! you will need your airship. it may be easy to craft, but good luck surviving and returning to your base to do so. and don't forget about the dragons... take care to not anger them by accidentally flying your ship over their territory. 

good luck, player!

## mod features:

### core:
Valkyrien Skies
Eureka!
ComputerCraft
Create
Grappling hook mod
Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks
TIS-3D

### QOL:
Essential Mod
The Joy of Painting
Music Maker Mod
WebDisplays
Catenary
Diagonal Fences
Distant Horizons
Boat Item View

### functional/new content:
The Aether (with lost content add-on, ruined portals and more)
Aetherial Islands (overworld generation)
Choice Theorem's Overhauled Village
More end structures

and a number of other mods that add more aesthetic items into the game.
